row.title: A continued sweep branch must run main's tools
row.body: SWEEP-BUDGET-1 lets a later pass continue the open sweep branch, which switched the working tree to that branch's stale copy of foundation/branchsweep.py; run 44497010885 therefore ran the pre-SWEEP-PRUNE-1 prune and deleted nothing although 88 branches were superseded. SWEEP-TOOLS-MAIN-1: after checking out the sweep branch the workflow restores foundation, scripts, tools and doctrine/branchsweep.json from origin/main.

title: A continued sweep branch must run main's tools
